theorem etcdstart.memberPresOn_of [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (N : Nat) (tok : GoString) (ms0 :
    List etcdstart.GMember) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (dir :
    w64 → List GoString) (Φs : w64 → w64 → List w8 → GName → IProp GF) (γn : NetNames GF) (ms : List
    etcdstart.GMember) (gs : List (etcdstart.MemberG GF)) (ids : List w64) (hids : List.map (fun x
    => x.id) gs = ids) (hlen : ms.length = gs.length) (m : lease.Mode := lease.Mode.none) : ⊢
    ([∗list] m;id ∈ ms;ids, etcdstart.bootPremiseOn N ps bootLog ctxs dir tok m.Name'
    (etcdstart.urlsN ms0 m) id) -∗ (□ ∀ lid, netHttpOk γn lid) -∗ ([∗list] g ∈ gs,
    etcdstart.memberBootOn g.γ ctxs g.ρ g.E Φs g.id false m) -∗ ([∗list] m ∈ ms,
    etcdstart.memberFreshRes m.Name' { peer := some m.Peer' } γn) -∗ [∗list] x ∈ ms.zip gs,
    etcdstart.memberPreOn N tok ms0 ps bootLog ctxs dir Φs γn x m

theorem etcdstart.memberBootsOn_ofM [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (γ : SrvRaft) (ps : List w64) (ctxs
    : List (List w8)) (issued cnt wn fs gen : GName) (γk : KVNames) (Φs : w64 → w64 → List w8 →
    GName → IProp GF) (γm : mvcc.api.MvccName) (idx : w64 → srvApi.KVSNames) (cok rev reg xs : w64 →
    GName) (Hiss : γk.ids.issued = issued) (Hwn : γk.ids.wn = wn) (Hfs : γk.ids.fs = fs) (Hgen :
    γk.ids.gen = gen) (Hc0 : γk.c0 = W64 0) (Hch : γk.ch0 = apply.alarmChain true false false) (Hlog
    : γk.log0 = [[], []]) (Hvs : γ.vs = ps) (Hkc : γk.cmp = false) (lm : lease.Mode) (hrun :
    lease.runCfg lm lm) (hne : lm = lease.Mode.revocable → lease.leasesNoExpiry) (Hklm : γk.lm = lm)
    (hpo : kvPfxOk γk) (L : List w64) (hpfx : ∀ (id : w64), id ∈ L → lm = lease.Mode.revocable →
    idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)) ∈ γk.gps) (HΦ : ∀ (id : w64), id ∈ L → Φs (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)))
    = srvFloorFacts (idx id).slog) (Hx : ∀ (id : w64), id ∈ L → xs (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id))) =
    (idx id).slog) : ⊢ srvRaftLogInv { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } -∗ idClusterInv issued
    cnt wn fs gen srvFloorFacts -∗ W64 0 ↪[issued]□ none -∗ srvPropMint { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0
    := W64 0 } γk.ids -∗ srvRdCtxInv { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } issued -∗ kvInvOn { raft
    := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } γk srvAuthSt0 -∗ ([∗list] id ∈ L, iprop((idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z
    id)), 0) ↪[cnt] ([], none) ∗ idKeyFactAt fs (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)), 0) (xs (idPfxOf (W16
    (uint.Z id)))) ∗ (nodeBoot γ.cl srvClusterN ps ctxs id ∗ raftState γ.cl id RaftState.init ∗
    nodeVacant γ.cl id) ∗ ∃ γd, ⌜γ.snapLoc id = some γd⌝ ∗ ghostMapAuth γd 1 ∅)) -∗ ([∗list] id ∈ L,
    idWaitTokAt wn (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)), 0)) -∗ ([∗list] id ∈ L,
    iprop(srvApi.newServerStoreFreshA (idx id) ∗ ghostMapAuth (cok id) 1 ∅ ∗ ghostMapAuth (rev id) 1
    ∅ ∗ ghostMapAuth (reg id) 1 ∅)) -∗ ([∗list] id ∈ L, idPfxInv gen (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id))))
    ==∗ ∃ gs, ⌜List.map (fun x => x.id) gs = L ∧ ∀ (g : etcdstart.MemberG GF), g ∈ gs →
    etcdstart.memberGOkOn γ γk g⌝ ∗ [∗list] g ∈ gs, etcdstart.memberBootOn g.γ ctxs g.ρ g.E Φs g.id
    false lm

theorem etcdstart.memberBootsOn_lm [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (ctxs : List (List w8)) (Φs : w64 →
    w64 → List w8 → GName → IProp GF) (lm : lease.Mode) (gs : List (etcdstart.MemberG GF)) :
    ([∗list] g ∈ gs, etcdstart.memberBootOn g.γ ctxs g.ρ g.E Φs g.id false lm) ⊢ ⌜∀ (g :
    etcdstart.MemberG GF), g ∈ gs → g.ρ.rd.kv.lm = lm⌝ ∗ [∗list] g ∈ gs, etcdstart.memberBootOn g.γ
    ctxs g.ρ g.E Φs g.id false lm

theorem etcdstart.allocNOnM [v3rpc_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions]
    (hne : mvcc.api.names_nonempty.law) (ids ps : List w64) (hperm : ps.Perm ids) (id0 : w64) (hid0
    : id0 ∈ ids) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (boot : List LogEntry) (Hbc : BootCore ps ctxs boot) (dir :
    w64 → List GoString) (ms : List (GoString × GoString × Option GoString)) (Hd0 : dir 0 = [])
    (Hhost : ∀ (i : w64) (h : GoString), go!"http://" ++ h ∈ dir i → h ∈ List.map (fun x =>
    x.snd.fst) ms) (Hrb : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2) (Hrb2 : receiptBound GF + boot.length ≤ 2 ^
    61) (lm : lease.Mode) (hrun : lease.runCfg lm lm) (hnx : lm = lease.Mode.revocable →
    lease.leasesNoExpiry) (hap : lm = lease.Mode.revocable → leaseIdsApart ids) (ns : Bool := false)
    : ⊢ bootMarshal ps ctxs (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) -∗ ([∗list] m ∈ ms, etcdstart.memberStartRes
    m.fst { peer := some m.snd.fst, client := m.snd.snd }) ={⊤}=∗ ∃ γ γk Φs γn gs, ⌜γ.vs = ps ∧
    γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0) (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) ∧ γ.boot = LogEntry.toEntries boot 0 ∧ γn.N
    = srvNet γ ∧ γn.dir = dir ∧ List.map (fun x => x.id) gs = ids ∧ (∀ (g : etcdstart.MemberG GF), g
    ∈ gs → etcdstart.memberGOkOn γ γk g) ∧ γk.c0 = W64 0 ∧ γk.log0 = [[], []]⌝ ∗ ⌜clusterNoSnap γ.cl
    ↔ ns = true⌝ ∗ (□ ∀ lid, netHttpOk γn lid) ∗ ([∗list] g ∈ gs, etcdstart.memberBootOn g.γ ctxs
    g.ρ g.E Φs g.id false lm) ∗ ([∗list] m ∈ ms, etcdstart.memberFreshRes m.fst { peer := some
    m.snd.fst, client := m.snd.snd } γn) ∗ etcdKV γk (kvStateOf (kvModelOn γk srvAuthSt0
    (bootEntries (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0)))) ∗ authHistView γk [srvAuthSt0]

theorem etcdstart.etcdKV_member [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (γ : SrvRaft) (γk : KVNames) (g :
    etcdstart.MemberG GF) (h : etcdstart.memberGOkOn γ γk g) (σ : KVState) : etcdKV γk σ ⊢ etcdKV
    g.ρ.rd.kv σ

theorem etcdstart.allocNOn [v3rpc_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions]
    (hne : mvcc.api.names_nonempty.law) (ids ps : List w64) (hperm : ps.Perm ids) (id0 : w64) (hid0
    : id0 ∈ ids) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (boot : List LogEntry) (Hbc : BootCore ps ctxs boot) (dir :
    w64 → List GoString) (ms : List (GoString × GoString × Option GoString)) (Hd0 : dir 0 = [])
    (Hhost : ∀ (i : w64) (h : GoString), go!"http://" ++ h ∈ dir i → h ∈ List.map (fun x =>
    x.snd.fst) ms) (Hrb : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2) (Hrb2 : receiptBound GF + boot.length ≤ 2 ^
    61) : ⊢ bootMarshal ps ctxs (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) -∗ ([∗list] m ∈ ms,
    etcdstart.memberStartRes m.fst { peer := some m.snd.fst, client := m.snd.snd }) ={⊤}=∗ ∃ γ γk Φs
    γn gs, ⌜γ.vs = ps ∧ γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0) (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) ∧ γ.boot =
    LogEntry.toEntries boot 0 ∧ γn.N = srvNet γ ∧ γn.dir = dir ∧ List.map (fun x => x.id) gs = ids ∧
    (∀ (g : etcdstart.MemberG GF), g ∈ gs → etcdstart.memberGOkOn γ γk g) ∧ γk.c0 = W64 0 ∧ γk.log0
    = [[], []]⌝ ∗ (□ ∀ lid, netHttpOk γn lid) ∗ ([∗list] g ∈ gs, etcdstart.memberBootOn g.γ ctxs g.ρ
    g.E Φs g.id) ∗ ([∗list] m ∈ ms, etcdstart.memberFreshRes m.fst { peer := some m.snd.fst, client
    := m.snd.snd } γn) ∗ etcdKV γk (kvStateOf (kvModelOn γk srvAuthSt0 (bootEntries
    (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0)))) ∗ authHistView γk [srvAuthSt0]

def etcdstart.memberGOkOn (γ : SrvRaft) (γk : KVNames) (g : etcdstart.MemberG GF) : Prop :=
  ∃ r,
    g.γ =
        { cl := γ.cl, vs := γ.vs, rule := γ.rule, boot := γ.boot, reg := r, snapLoc := γ.snapLoc, log := γ.log,
          fresh := γ.fresh, props := γ.props, fired := γ.fired, rdFresh := γ.rdFresh, pend := γ.pend,
          authOn := γ.authOn } ∧
      g.ρ.rd.raft =
          {
            raft :=
              { cl := γ.cl, vs := γ.vs, rule := γ.rule, boot := γ.boot, reg := r, snapLoc := γ.snapLoc, log := γ.log,
                fresh := γ.fresh, props := γ.props, fired := γ.fired, rdFresh := γ.rdFresh, pend := γ.pend,
                authOn := γ.authOn },
            pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } ∧
        g.ρ.rd.kv.st = γk.st ∧
          g.ρ.rd.kv.c0 = γk.c0 ∧ g.ρ.rd.kv.ch0 = γk.ch0 ∧ g.ρ.rd.kv.log0 = γk.log0 ∧ g.ρ.rd.kv.hist = γk.hist

theorem etcdstart.authHistView_member [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (γ : SrvRaft) (γk : KVNames) (g :
    etcdstart.MemberG GF) (h : etcdstart.memberGOkOn γ γk g) (hs : List auth.AuthState) :
    authHistView γk hs ⊢ authHistView g.ρ.rd.kv hs

theorem etcdstart.sameCluster_of_gOkOn [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (γ : SrvRaft) (γk : KVNames) (g g' :
    etcdstart.MemberG GF) (h : etcdstart.memberGOkOn γ γk g) (h' : etcdstart.memberGOkOn γ γk g') :
    etcdstart.sameCluster g.ρ g'.ρ
